PROJECT CONTEXT

Evidence first.

Site work has established an early local operation. The next stage is not built on unsupported resource or return claims: it begins with independent review, controlled production records, gold accounting and clear operating responsibilities.

Legal-rights language, workforce numbers, equipment arrangements and technical results will be published only after their sources, effective dates and professional approvals are complete.

DEVELOPMENT PATHWAY

Four controlled steps.

  1. 01 / VerifyIndependent inspection, data review and a controlled baseline programme.
  2. 02 / StabiliseSafety, production, fuel, equipment-hours and custody reconciliation.
  3. 03 / ExpandMilestone-based capacity decisions supported by operating evidence.
  4. 04 / ExploreA professionally designed pathway for primary-gold exploration.

What remains to be established

Mining is inherently uncertain. Material work includes confirming rights wording, technical interpretation, recovery performance, costs, environmental obligations, community context and the commercial basis for expansion. Qualified partners receive controlled information through a reviewed diligence process.
